title: Study on Visual Performance of a Monofocal Intraocular Lens
brief_summary: Retrospective/Prospective Study on Visual Performance of a Monofocal Intraocular Lens (IOL). The objective is to compare best corrected distance visual acuity (CDVA) between 1-3-month and 12- month follow-up.
study_population: Cataract patients already implanted with a monofocal IOL
